'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[2024 Kiryat Malakhi attack]]
***Two people are killed and four others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a bus station near [[Kiryat Malachi]], [[Israel]]. The perpetrator is killed by an off-duty [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] reservist. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/02/16/Three-people-seriously-wounded-in-suspected-shooting-in-Israel-medics-and-police-say (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/two-killed-4-hurt-in-terror-attack-at-reem-junction-in-south-israel-gunman-killed/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Avdiivka (2022–2024)|Battle of Avdiivka]]
***[[Ukraine]] announces the withdrawal of its [[Ukrainian Ground Forces|troops]] from positions in the south of [[Avdiivka]] amid heavy clashes with [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian forces]] for control of the city. The withdrawal comes a day after [[Russia]]n soldiers entered the city from multiple directions. [https://www.kyivpost.com/post/28161 (''Kyiv Post'')]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[United States|U.S.]] officials confirm that a [[cyberattack]] was carried out on the MV ''Beshad'', an [[Iran|Iranian]] [[spy ship]] in the [[Red Sea]], to prevent the ship from sharing intelligence with [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] forces in [[Yemen]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/investigations/us-conducted-cyberattack-suspected-iranian-spy-ship-rcna138638 (NBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five workers are killed and three others are injured after a supermarket under construction collapses in [[Florence]], [[Italy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-florence-supermarket-construction-site-workers-accident-3f305f164cd4104880afef08f95f6ef4 (AP)]
*One [[firefighter]] is killed and 11 other people are injured after a house [[Explosion|explodes]] in [[Sterling, Virginia|Sterling]], [[Virginia]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/02/16/us/sterling-virginia-house-explosion-firefighters/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Death and funeral of Alexei Navalny]]
**[[Alexei Navalny]], a prominent [[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|Russian opposition]] leader and a vocal critic of [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]], dies while serving a 19-year sentence at the [[FKU IK-3, Kharp|Polar Wolf]] penal colony in [[Tyumen Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/02/16/europe/alexey-navalny-dead-russia-prison-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[LGBT rights in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines]]
**The High Court of [[Saint Vincent and the Grenadines]] rejects a challenge to the colonial anti-LGBT laws in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/saint-vincent-court-rejects-challenge-colonial-era-anti-gay-laws-2024-02-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[New York civil investigation of The Trump Organization]]
**Former [[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] is fined over $350 million by the [[New York Supreme Court]] and temporarily barred from business in [[New York (state)|New York]] as a result of [[The Trump Organization]]'s financial fraud. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/02/16/nyregion/trump-civil-fraud-trial-ruling.html (''The New York Times'')]
*A [[drive-by]] mass shooting in [[Birmingham, Alabama]], [[United States]] kills four people. All four victims are friends of the 20-year-old gunman Lamarion Tykese Charlie. [https://www.gunviolencearchive.org/incident/2831391 (GVA)]
